headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Annualized allocated revenue across Network & AI Security, Cortex, and Idira/CyberArk platforms.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Next-Generation Security (NGS) ARR ($B): Reached $9.10B in Q4 FY26 (+63% YoY, adding nearly $1B net new in a single quarter). Management guided Q1 FY27E to $9.54B–$9.56B (+63% YoY including CyberArk/Idira & Chronosphere); buy-side whisper targets $9.75B+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP net revenue recognized across Subscription & Support and Product.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): Q4 FY26 revenue grew +34.4% YoY to $3,410.0M (vs $2,474.0M in Q1 FY26). Management guided Q1 FY27E to $3,300M–$3,310M (+33%–34% YoY); Street consensus is $3,307.46M, while buy-side whisper targets $3,365.0M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Adjusted diluted EPS excluding SBC, acquisition-related costs, intangible amortization, and convertible note fair-value marks.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Q4 FY26 printed $1.02 (+4.35% beat vs $0.98 est). Management guided Q1 FY27E to $0.96–$0.98 (consensus $0.97 on 837M–844M diluted shares); whisper bogey expects $1.01+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Contracted future revenue under multi-year non-cancelable customer agreements.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) ($B): Reached $21.20B in Q4 FY26 (+34% YoY). Management guided Q1 FY27E to $20.80B–$20.90B (+34%–35% YoY, reflecting normal Q1 seasonal dip); buy-side whisper looks for $21.30B+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Quarterly enterprise customers newly consolidating onto multi-platform PANW architectures (excluding CyberArk/Chronosphere baseline).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Net New Platformizations (#/qtr): PANW added a record ~220 net new platformizations in Q4 FY26 (with >65% of NGS ARR coming from platformized customers at >120% NRR). Consensus expects ~160–180 seasonal Q1 adds; whisper requires 195+.
